text:
Sam: Handoff: NebulaCore closed today. Quick context: mid-market analytics vendor. Wants hosted API to start, but legal requested a short Private eval for EU data residency. Uses embeddings + semantic search; expected spike month-1. Sales saw an isolated EU latency cluster last perf run. Procurement pushing for 12mo pricing decision in ~5 weeks. Renewal/watch risk if onboarding delayed.

Evelyn: I'll own CS. Sam, drop final contract + perf snippet and the SSO admin contact? Also share any customer-run traffic samples.

Sam: Links: https://drive.redwood/NebulaCore/contract_signed.pdf and https://logs.redwood/nebulacore/eu-latency-sample.log. SSO admin: ops@nebulacore.io. PO: lena@nebulacore.io

Evelyn: Plan: 1) Confirm owners & comms, 2) EU smoke perf test, 3) SSO (SAML) handshake + test, 4) Embedding forecast + cost controls, 5) Private eval if perf/SSO blocks. Owners: Evelyn (CS lead), Noah (Support: SUP-11009), Claire (Eng: private sizing).

Noah: Created ticket SUP-11009. I'll start runbook and need steps to reproduce spike + a minimal reproducer payload. Can they run a short test from their EU VMs?

Claire: For sizing/perf please provide: model name, typical seq length, expected concurrent queries, and a sample embed workload (CSV ok). Sample stress command I'll run:

```bash
# small-load example using curl loop
for i in {1..200}; do 
  curl -s -X POST "https://api.redwood/v1/embeddings" \
    -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" \
    -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
    -d '{"model":"embed-large-v1","input":"sample text '$i'"}' &
done; wait
```

Claire: If we see throttles we can ask infra for a temporary test pool.

Evelyn: Uploading prompt set and a 7-day embed sample to shared folder now. Also requesting NebulaCore to provide three success metrics: P50/P95 latency, embed cost per 10k, and SAML pass % for the handshake.

Sam: I'll ask ops@nebulacore.io to approve a SAML test window Tue 08:00-10:00 UTC next week and share test VMs if they can. Procurement note: they'll want a pricing term comparison; SalesOps looped in.

Noah: SUP-11009 checklist seeds: reproduce spike, collect request IDs / traces, confirm regional routing, capture KV-cache hit rates if applicable. Added 'mitigation' section for quick-rate-limits or routing change.

onboard-bot: Enterprise onboarding checklist linked: https://wiki.redwood/onboard/templates/enterprise. Added "EU perf smoke" step and SAML checklist.

Evelyn: Owners & immediate next steps: - CS: Evelyn -> kickoff + weekly summary - Support: Noah -> SUP-11009 + runbook - Eng: Claire -> perf tests + private eval sizing - Sales: Sam -> SAML approval + procurement timeline

Evelyn: Short-term commitments (this week): 1) Sam to secure SAML approval from ops@nebulacore.io by EOD Thu. 2) Noah to attach logs + reproducer to SUP-11009 in 24h. 3) Claire to review perf logs and confirm any extra data needed in 48h. 4) Evelyn to run preliminary cost forecast and propose throttling/ caching mitigations in 72h.

Claire: I'll review the log now and post questions in-thread. Expect initial perf notes in ~30h.

Sam: Looping procurement contact lena@nebulacore.io. Noted on renewal watch.

Evelyn: Weekly sync cadence: Friday 13:00 UTC. Marking account as "onboarding-watch" until SAML validated + first smoke pass. If blocked earlier, ping here and tag @Noah or @Claire.

Noah: Added initial reproducer to SUP-11009 and noted the perf log link.

Evelyn: Thanks all — I'll publish kickoff note after SAML window confirmed. :thumbsup:
